ideas.title: Ride it down: Lumi on the cart over the crest, one brake lever with three throws
ideas.goal: The player, as Lumi, sits on the cart's deck and rides it over a crest of the dune. One lever on the deck has three throws: free (the motor's circuit open, the cart runs away), BACK INTO THE POTS (the motor is a generator charging the clay cells, a gentle brake that grows with speed), and THE STRAP (a copper strap shorts the motor, a hard brake that turns the run into heat and can make the belt slip). The run scores two things the physics decides: where the cart comes to rest against a stake at the bottom, and how much charge went back into the pots. Brake hard and you stop on the stake but waste it; brake gently and you charge, but may roll past. Every run is a judgement made with your hand on the lever, so you get better at it.
ideas.toward: 'Braking that charges the plates' on the road, played instead of watched: the cart's energy going back into its battery on a downhill, which is how the big goal's dune run must end (and with three friends aboard, the same lever decides whether they stop safely).
ideas.idea: Nothing is scripted: the cartcord Sim gets a three-way switch in its circuit. Into the pots, current flows backwards by itself once the drum's back-EMF (kt * omega, from Motor2D) passes the six pots' EMF plus the cord's IR; the pots' potcell model runs backwards (copper back into solution at Faraday's rate) and the charge counts up from that. Into the strap, I = kt*omega/R_strap, torque kt^2*omega/R_strap, energy into the winding's heat. The road follows the real ground over the crest (laid from the ground, not a preset bench); slope per wheel from the terrain; Lumi's own mass on the deck. Watchers see Lumi on the deck pulling the lever, the cart slowing on the slope as if on a leash, the belt squealing on a hard throw, and the cart stopping a hand short of the stake, or not.
ideas.form: A new kind of game for the island: a ride in Jump in (Lumi seated on the cart, the lever on keys), in the human's game, with its two scores shown as the cart's own gauges (a needle swinging back past zero as it charges). A daylight film from beside the crest of Lumi riding down with its hand on the lever.

ideas.title: The cart takes the dune: Lumi rides, and the charge decides where it stops
ideas.goal: The player lays the plank road from the pots over the crest of the dune and rides the cart up with Lumi aboard: whether it reaches the top depends on the road's steepest stretch, the pulley and how far the pots have been drained; over the top it brakes itself and charges them back. You plan the road to get over with the least charge spent, and to win back the most on the far side.
ideas.toward: The big goal's dune run itself, first with Lumi as the only rider: climb, stall or crest, then braking that charges.
ideas.idea: The same Sim and circuit, a road the player lays plank by plank over the real terrain (each plank's slope from the ground under its ends), the pots' state carried from run to run so a drained day shows on the next climb.
ideas.form: A ride in Jump in in the human's game; a daylight film of the cart cresting with Lumi aboard.
